questions.question: A digital gauge displays 7.5. If the maximum reading is 10, what percentage of the scale is shown?
questions.fastStrategy: Divide reading by maximum and multiply by 100.

questions.question: An altimeter shows an altitude of 8,000 feet. How many meters is this? (1 foot = 0.3048 meters)
steps: 2. Apply conversion factor: 0.3048 m per foot.
questions.fastStrategy: Multiply feet by 0.3048 to convert to meters.
